SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal relationships is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal relationships never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal relationships.
   C. Explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Diversity and interpersonal relationships as rumours only.

4. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

5. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   C. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   D. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6.
   B. Explain Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Maps and Map Work 10 4.4 Earth and the Solar System 5 4.5 Weather 5 Page 13 of 6 as rumours only.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   B. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.
   D. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

12. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   C. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.

13. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   C. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.
   C. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   C. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Maps and map work is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Maps and map work never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Maps and map work as rumours only.
   C. Explain Maps and map work with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Maps and map work.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Developments in Medium of trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal relationships and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
